description: This file defines a 'Polygon' class for managing polygon shapes on a Leaflet map within a widget, including creation, updating, styling, event handling, and tooltips.

classes.name: Polygon
classes.description: A class for creating and managing polygon shapes on a Leaflet map, supporting editing, tooltips, labels, and dynamic updates.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a Polygon instance, creates the Leaflet polygon, sets up tooltips, labels, and event listeners.

methods.name: createEventListeners
methods.description: Sets up event listeners for editing, rotating, dragging, and clicking on the polygon.

methods.name: updateTooltip
methods.description: Updates the tooltip content based on the current data and settings.

methods.name: updateLabel
methods.description: Updates the polygon's label tooltip with processed pattern data.

methods.name: updatePolygon
methods.description: Updates the polygon's shape, style, tooltip, and label based on new data and settings.

methods.name: removePolygon
methods.description: Removes the polygon layer from the map.

methods.name: updatePolygonColor
methods.description: Updates the fill and stroke colors of the polygon.

methods.name: getPolygonLatLngs
methods.description: Returns the current latitude/longitude points of the polygon.

methods.name: setPolygonLatLngs
methods.description: Sets new latitude/longitude points for the polygon and redraws it.

methods.name: getPolygonColor
methods.description: Calculates the polygon fill color based on settings and data.

methods.name: getPolygonStrokeColor
methods.description: Calculates the polygon stroke color based on settings and data.
